info.name: Notes+
info.summary: Google-Keep-style notes: colored tags, colors, cards — sync-safe Markdown
info.description:
Notes+ is a community fork of the Nextcloud Notes app that adds the Google-Keep-style features the official app has long declined — colored multi-tag labels, per-note colors, archive, a card grid, and first-class checklists — while keeping every note as a plain, sync-safe Markdown file in your Nextcloud (editable from any client). Colors and tags live in the note's front-matter, so your notes stay portable and exportable. A separate REST API allows easy integration. Fork of [Nextcloud Notes](https://github.com/nextcloud/notes) (AGPL-3.0-or-later).
NOTE: the app id / PHP namespace are still `notes` during early development; they are renamed to `notesplus` as a build-verified step before app-store publish (see the plan). The official mobile apps target the upstream `notes` app and do not connect to this fork.
